body.x: Stage8 will work with the Incheon Economic and Industrial Information Techno Park for 4 days from January 8 (Tue) to January 11 (Fri), in "MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT '(BOOTH # 52843) at CES 2019 EUREKA PARK, the world's largest technology exhibition, held in Las Vegas, USA, and introduce the web platform for music and sound content.

STAGE8 provides a platform for referencing and producing music contents (BGM, Sound, SFX) in order to coexist with musicians and content producers. STAGE8 officials said, "By improving the work process in the industrial music market, it gives musicians an opportunity to generate economic profits and provides excellent music resources for users who are experiencing difficulties and limitations in the supply of music." I said.

The features of the platform are as follows. △ Request and make purchases of sound contents on the internet △ 'Musician recommendation service' which saves user's time △ Provides web contents service to acquire various idea works of various musicians in customized sound production.
STAGE8, which will participate in the world's largest technology exhibition 'CES 2019' held in Las Vegas from January 8 to 11, said, "We plan to start global service in 2019."

On the other hand, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT, which is a global project zone which is formed as part of a project to help Korea's start-up into the global market, is attracting attention with various activities such as exhibition, pitching and party. Also, on the third evening of the exhibition, MIK NIGHT party, a business networking party, will be held. In addition, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT will be jointly planned and operated by AVING NEWS and GMEG, a global MICE specialist company.

CES 2019 is an innovative exhibition where technology companies that will lead the fourth industrial revolution will participate. The main categories are 3D Printing, Accessibility, Advertising, Marketing, Content and Entertainment, AR / VR and Gaming, Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Audio and Video , Baby Tech, CES Sports Zone, Country Pavilions, Design & Source Showcase, Digital Money, Drones, Enterprise Solutions, Eureka Park, Family and Kids Tech, Fitness, Health and Wellness, Home Cinema, IoT Infrastructure, iProducts , Resilience, Self-Driving Technology, Sleep Tech, Smart Cities, Smart Home, Sports Tech, Tourism, Vehicle Technology, Wearables, Wireless Devices and Services.
